title: Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account Service Orders: Replacement Cards and Written History
content:
**Replacement cards.**
- A replacement card for the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account is ordered only for an account whose status is active or blocked.
- A card reported lost or stolen is blocked before its replacement is ordered, and its replacement carries a new card number.
- A damaged card is replaced on the same number while the account stays active.
- A card nearing expiry is reissued as an expiring-card order.
- Standard delivery takes the plan's standard delivery period in business days, and expedited delivery the plan's expedited delivery period.
- Replacement and shipping fees follow the service fee rules of the account.

**Account history.**
- The cardholder may ask at any time for a written history covering up to the plan's written history months, mailed at the plan's written history fee. The date it is sent counts as history access for error notices.
- Online and in-app history covers the plan's electronic history months.

| Reason for the order | Account status before the order | Card number |
|---|---|---|
| lost | blocked | new number |
| stolen | blocked | new number |
| damaged | active | same number |
| expiring | active | reissued |

*Hypothetical case:* a cardholder who reports a stolen card on an active account first has the card blocked, and then the replacement is ordered on a new number. A closed account cannot order a replacement.
